children: New opportunities expand educational pathways for nursing students and strengthen healthcare workforce partnerships

COLUMBUS, Ohio, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hondros College of Nursing announced its combination with American Public University System (the System), an important milestone that expands opportunities for current and future students, strengthening its ability to support students and address evolving healthcare workforce needs. Hondros College of Nursing is now formally called Hondros College of Nursing part of American Public University System.
The System is institutionally accredited by the

(HLC), an institutional accrediting agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education and the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA). As an Academic Unit of the System, Hondros College of Nursing now operates under American Public University System's institutional accreditation.

For more than two decades, Hondros College of Nursing has prepared thousands of licensed practical nurses and registered nurses through its student-centered, laddered approach to nursing education. Serving students through eight campuses across Ohio, Indiana, and Michigan, Hondros College of Nursing has built strong relationships with healthcare partners and communities throughout the region. Now, as part of the System, which also includes

, students have expanded opportunities to continue their educational journeys with pathways to pursue bachelor's, master's and doctoral nursing education, along with additional degree programs that support career advancement and lifelong learning.

"This marks an exciting new chapter," said David Kramer, interim president of Hondros College of Nursing part of American Public University System. "For more than twenty years, we've helped students launch rewarding nursing careers, and now we're expanding opportunities for them to continue their education and professional growth."

This milestone reflects the shared commitment of Hondros College of Nursing and the entire American Public University System to providing high-quality, career-focused education that prepares graduates to make a meaningful impact in healthcare and the communities they serve.

ABOUT HONDROS COLLEGE OF NURSING PART OF AMERICAN PUBLIC UNIVERSITY SYSTEM:

Hondros College of Nursing part of the American Public University System (the System), educates students at six Ohio campuses, one campus in Indiana and one in Michigan. Hondros offers the Practical Nursing Diploma program. Hondros College of Nursing is dedicated to its mission as well as the students, partners, and communities in which they serve. For additional information, please visit  hondros.edu. For complete information about accreditation, please visit hondros.edu/accreditation. Hondros College of Nursing cannot guarantee employment or salary. The System is a wholly owned subsidiary of American Public Education, Inc. (

American Public University System empowers students through education to transform lives, advance careers, and serve their communities locally and globally. With approximately 109,000 students and over 250,000 alumni worldwide, the System includes American Military University (AMU), American Public University (APU), Rasmussen University, and Hondros College of Nursing.

The System is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission, an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. The System is a wholly owned subsidiary of American Public Education, Inc. (Nasdaq: APEI)

American Public Education, Inc. (Nasdaq: APEI) is a leading provider of career-focused higher education, delivering respected, innovative, and affordable programs and services through the American Public University System (the System). Through the System, APEI prepares students for service-oriented careers while expanding access to high-quality, workforce-relevant education.
